column2: local	entrepreneurs	to	make	affordable	broadband	access	a	reality	for	communities
In 2017 we launched a comprehensive US rural broadband strategy to help
connect at least 25 million Americans without access to broadband, of which more
than 19 million people live in rural communities. We have committed to connect
3	million	of	these	people	through	Airband	partnerships,	invest	in	making	specific
